provenance.asset_description: Two separate illustrations overlayed over a blurred background. On the left is a human, Chelaxian naval captain standing tall, her hair pulled back in a severe bun and she has a haughty look on her face. On the right is an aged and scarred clangit gremlin, raising a gloved hand to call for help, with a tool clutched in his other hand.
